scope: Two additional original power-system agent studies; primary full papers and author repository inspected. No experiments executed.

E03.title: Grid-Agent: An LLM-Powered Multi-Agent System for Power Grid Control
E03.authors: Yan Zhang, Ahmad Mohammad Saber, Amr Youssef, Deepa Kundur

E04.title: VeraGrid-Agent: Tool-Augmented LLMs for Distribution Optimal Power Flow at the Grid Edge
E04.authors: Shivanshu Tripathi, Hamed Mohsenian-Rad, Maziar Raissi

E04C.title: Shivanshu-11/veragrid-llm-benchmark
E04C.evidence_type: Author implementation, benchmark and recorded-run repository

papers.architecture_locator: Section IV, Algorithm 1, PDF p.4; Figure 1 and rollback design, p.5
papers.architecture: Topology agent establishes violations; planner returns JSON action calls; executor applies them to a sandbox; validator recomputes violations and rolls back unsuccessful changes; summarizer records outcomes. State drives the next planning cycle.
papers.solver: Numerical power-flow solver; implementation brand not identified in full v3 paper
papers.orchestration_sdk: Not identified; do not label this LangGraph, AutoGen or OpenAI Agents SDK
execution_recipe: Copy network into sandbox and analyze violations.
Ask planner for allowed structured actions.
Execute actions and rerun power flow.
Validate improvement, revert failures, repeat within iteration budget.
papers.task: Resolve voltage, thermal and disconnected-bus violations using switching, battery placement/dispatch and load curtailment.
papers.setup_locator: Section V.A–C, Tables I–II, PDF pp.5–6
papers.denominator_caveat: Seven named scenarios are described; exact aggregate trial count and repetition/weighting protocol are undisclosed. Do not convert percentages into successes/7.
papers.result_locator: Section V.D, PDF p.6; Figure 2a, PDF p.7
papers.metric: Reported percentage of fully resolved violation scenarios
papers.baseline: Different LLM planners inside the same architecture; no numerical-optimizer comparator established
papers.uncertainty: No confidence interval supplied for these percentages
papers.limits: Prototype simulation evidence; formal optimality and comparison against mixed-integer nonlinear OPF are future work (Section VI, p.9). Simulation rollback does not establish reversible physical switching.
reporting_ambiguities: CIGRE MV is described as 15-bus in prose but Table I lists 14 buses.
Action-efficiency Figure 3 is conditional on successful runs.
Older search metadata uses the original Semantic Reasoning title and mentions reinforcement learning; cite current v3 title/architecture.
papers.code_status: No author code repository linked in the full v3 PDF or arXiv record; targeted search did not verify one. Author website links the preprint only.

papers.architecture_locator: Figure 2 and Section II.C–D, PDF pp.2–3
papers.architecture: ReAct controller writes JSON feeder input, executes VeraGrid AC-OPF, receives metadata and a results table of contents, reads selected output lines, and chooses an MCQ option. Each question has an isolated workspace; errors may trigger correction and retry within a finite budget.
papers.task: Numerical questions about solved voltages, flows, dispatch, losses and DER behavior
papers.network_locator: Section IV, PDF p.3; Figure 3, p.4

benchmark.name: VeraGrid-MCQ-150
benchmark.ground_truth: VeraGrid solution on the same circuit

papers.metric: Correct MCQ options / 150; missing or malformed answers count incorrect
papers.baseline: Same model answering from feeder/DER description without solver access; agent includes iteration and tool feedback
papers.repetitions: Unspecified; do not infer run-to-run uncertainty
papers.limits: Single balanced feeder; template-derived questions share one solved circuit. MCQ success is not dispatch-policy optimality, restoration performance, field reliability or a valid percentage across arbitrary feeders.
reporting_ambiguities: Abstract gives no-tool range 42.7–49.3%, while Table I includes Opus 4.8 at 41.3%; use table counts.
System-prompt example mentions buses 17 and 30 despite the evaluated 8-bus feeder; do not copy this example as its exact case definition.
Table II includes one no-tool-use failure for Composer 2.5; do not claim every error is interpretation after successful execution.

code.status: Author repository verified; source-inspected, not executed
code.runtime: README uses Cursor Agent CLI; optional Claude Code backend. These are repository execution interfaces, not an SDK named by the paper.
code.setup: Install requirements.txt with VeraGridEngine; make cursor-agent available and authenticated. Existing JSONL supports report generation without new model calls.
